resource_risks.description: The bridge may start a native PTY process before starting an agent CLI session.
resource_risks.mitigation: The bridge reuses existing start_native_pty_terminal and cancel_native_pty_terminal paths; it does not add a new daemon or detached process owner.

resource_risks.description: A failed CLI session start could be reported as a successful desktop action.
resource_risks.mitigation: createCliAdapterSession throws on Tauri or CLI start failure; startSelectedLaneAction and startTerminalAgentBridge let runDesktopAction mark failure.

resource_risks.description: The feature could add a new long-running background supervisor.
resource_risks.rationale: No new supervisor, interval, worker, or dependency was added; existing PTY and CLI stores remain the only runtime owners.
